summary: Tables and tabbed pages open in a new Revolutionary style with clearer grid lines, and a Color Theme card on Home lets you preview it beside the original Classic style and switch.
details: Revolutionary keeps tables flat and quiet: slate grid lines you can see, pale headers, softer selection colours, and flat tabs with an underline.
Classic is the look the app had before; pick it on the Home Color Theme card to switch back.
The Color Theme card shows a live snapshot of each style and a Light / Dark switch, and a choice applies at once.
The High Contrast theme has been removed; anyone who had chosen it now opens in Light.
